toxicn-taskb-harmful.classification_categories: Targeted Harmful, Sexual Innuendo, General Offense, or Dispirited Culture.

definitions.Targeted Harmful: Content that demeans, stereotypes, stigmatizes, expresses hostility toward, or attacks a specific individual, group, identity, nationality, gender, occupation, organization, or otherwise identifiable target.
definitions.Sexual Innuendo: Content that implies sexual behavior, sexual body parts, sexual attraction, or adult situations through text, imagery, puns, metaphors, or scene composition, even when not explicitly graphic.
definitions.General Offense: Content containing vulgar insults, threats, derogatory language, aggressive tone, or offensive expression where the target is not a clearly identifiable specific group or object.
definitions.Dispirited Culture: Content expressing pessimism, defeatism, self-mockery, low motivation, giving up, lying flat, nihilistic feelings, failure, or a bleak attitude toward life.
